name: pi-cloud-mode-extension
description: Build/verify entry point for the Cloud Mode extension, worker and CDK app.

scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:infra && npm run sast
scripts._comment_typecheck: Advisory only: the extension's peer deps (pi SDK/TUI) are provided by the host at runtime and are not installed here, so tsc reports missing modules in a bare clone.
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ext && npm run typecheck:cdk
scripts.typecheck:cdk: cd cdk && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit cloud-mode-stack.ts --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --skipLibCheck
scripts.audit: for p in worker cdk .pi/extensions/cloud-mode; do (cd $p && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high) || exit 1; done
